# serve command reference

`quillmark serve` builds the site in memory and hosts it on a local web server for previewing.

## Options

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| --port | 8630 | TCP port the preview server binds to. |
| --bind | 127.0.0.1 | Interface to bind. Use 0.0.0.0 to preview from other devices. |
| --drafts | false | Include pages still marked as drafts. |
| --rebuild | on-change | Rebuild on file changes; set to `manual` to rebuild by hand. |

## Notes

The preview server is for local review only and sets `noindex` headers on every response. Deployed sites are served by the output of `quillmark build` and do not inherit these settings.

Last reviewed 2026-07-22.

web_fixture.content:
# Serve command binds a different port on every machine?

**fenne-vdbrg opened this issue on 2026-06-15**

Our onboarding wiki (now retired) claimed a fixed port for `quillmark serve`, but on my machine the server clearly binds elsewhere from time to time. Is the default randomized per install?

**tgrauslyn commented on 2026-06-16**

It is not randomized. `--port` has one fixed default; what you are seeing is the auto-fallback that kicks in when that port is already taken on the machine. The current default is documented on the serve command reference page under docs.quillmark.dev.
